orbOnHit_life.desc: Life and mana orb hit rolls share a 0.75s interval per kind.

satelliteCount.label: Additional Satellites
satelliteCount.desc: Adds satellites to families you already carry, up to the shared carrying limit.

satelliteOrbit.label: Satellite Orbit Radius
satelliteOrbit.desc: Scales how far your satellites orbit from your body.

satelliteSpeed.label: Satellite Orbit Speed
satelliteSpeed.desc: Scales the turning speed of your orbiting satellites.

satelliteCount_shelter_barrier.label: Unbroken Orbit Satellites
satelliteCount_shelter_barrier.desc: An intact guard remnant reflects projectiles that touch its armed surface.

satelliteCount_shelter_thorns.label: Splinter Orbit Satellites
satelliteCount_shelter_thorns.desc: A broken guard remnant deals a share of its source shield bash on contact.

satelliteCount_iron_wake.label: Iron Wake Satellites
satelliteCount_iron_wake.desc: An untargetable hollow iron orb revolves around you, striking enemies on contact. Additional grants add orbs. Scales with physical and satellite damage, not minion damage.

satelliteCount_cinder_wake.label: Cinder Wake Satellites
satelliteCount_cinder_wake.desc: An orbiting ember lobs fire mortars at nearby enemies. Additional grants add orbs. Scales with fire, area and satellite damage.

satelliteCount_storm_wake.label: Storm Wake Satellites
satelliteCount_storm_wake.desc: An orbiting relic fires lightning orbs. Additional grants add satellites; lightning, projectile and satellite damage scale the payload.

satelliteCount_rime_wake.label: Rime Wake Satellites
satelliteCount_rime_wake.desc: A cold satellite lines up distant enemies, then fires a swift piercing needle. Additional grants add satellites; cold, projectile and satellite damage scale its hits.

auroraCapacity.label: Additional Aurora Capacity
auroraCapacity.desc: Adds storage to aurora reservoirs you already carry.

auroraRecharge.label: Aurora Recharge Rate
auroraRecharge.desc: Scales how quickly your aurora reservoirs replenish stored projectiles.

auroraCapacity_pall.label: Pall Aurora Capacity
auroraCapacity_pall.desc: Pale bubbles gather, cascade outward near enemies, then replenish. Capacity stacks; chaos, projectile and aurora damage scale their hits.

creeperCount_barrow.label: Barrow Creeper Count
creeperCount_barrow.desc: A protected burrower roams beside you, pursues nearby enemies and erupts beneath them. Straying prey breaks its pursuit; it returns before hunting again.

guardianRecharge.label: Guardian Recharge Rate
guardianRecharge.desc: Scales how quickly your projectile guardians become ready after an interception.

guardianCount_graveglass.label: Graveglass Guardians
guardianCount_graveglass.desc: A spectral pane breaks to intercept one incoming hostile projectile, then reforms. Additional grants add panes. Does not stop melee, beams or ground damage.

combo_spellblade_weave.label: Grammar: Blade-and-Vein
combo_spellblade_weave.desc: Weave the lanes: an attack and a spell back-to-back (either order) surge your attack and cast speed. Keep alternating to stack the surge.

combo_elemental_round.label: Grammar: Prismatic Round
combo_elemental_round.desc: Cast three DIFFERENT elements in a row to close the round: elemental damage surges while the prism holds.

combo_grapplers_rhythm.label: Grammar: Takedown
combo_grapplers_rhythm.desc: Seize, then THROW. A grab followed by a throw closes the measure: your blows land harder and your grip grows surer while the rhythm holds.

combo_liturgy.label: Grammar: The Responsory
combo_liturgy.desc: Call and response: sing two DIFFERENT songs back-to-back and the Responsory answers with a radiant burst that harms the court and heals the congregation in one circle.

combo_twin_measures.label: Grammar: Twin Measures
combo_twin_measures.desc: Strike with two DIFFERENT attack skills back-to-back to close the measure: damage and poise damage surge while the weave holds.

combo_drumbeat.label: Grammar: Drumbeat
combo_drumbeat.desc: Land the SAME skill three times running to strike the drum: damage and poise damage surge, stacking with every completed measure.

combo_glimmer_chorus.label: Grammar: Glimmer Chorus
combo_glimmer_chorus.desc: Cast the SAME spell three times running to close the sign: the chorus answers, and lightning damage and cast speed surge while the light holds.

combo_kettle_tattoo.label: Grammar: Kettle Tattoo
